jobs.description:
Who you are

Do you love to get up before everybody else and drive a forklift truck? If so, you are a good match as a forklift driver for our goods receiving department. When IKEA opens at 10 AM, it is important we have emptied the trucks, received goods, and replenished the shelves so we are ready for our customers. In this job it is a requirement that you have a license for operating forklift trucks and experience with driving both reach trucks and powered stacker.

In addition we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle hard manual labor

• Thrive by working during the night and early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a danish forklift license - or are willing to acquire it

• Are detail-oriented and comfortable working with software and digital tools

A day in your life with us

As a forklift driver you play an important part for IKEA’s customers and sales, because you and your team make sure our home furnishing solutions and accessories are always accessible for our customers. Every day is fast paced because we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Your tasks will be:

• Receiving and handling goods by unloading trucks and loading goods into the warehouse by driving reach truck and powered stacker

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Handling of goods and stock taking, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department.

Together as a team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Logistics Team Leader, Chrysostomos Milas (chrysostomos.milas@ingka.ikea.com). Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Other information

• This position is for an average of 32 hours pr. week

• Your working time will vary based on the business need, with shifts primarily in the night and early morning hours from 02:30-10:00. You should also expect to work every second weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input for the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience - whether you are young, senior, or somewhere in between. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

**We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel for a regional role in the global energy sector

**Join Øglænd System and the Hilti Group as Legal Counsel in a maternity leave cover position. You will work on complex offshore energy projects, support major commercial negotiations, and collaborate with colleagues across an international business. For the right candidate, this is an opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility from day one while building valuable experience within a global industry leader.

Based in Kleppe, Norway (alternative location at our office in Haderslev, Denmark can also be considered), you will work closely with regional stakeholders while interfacing extensively with global legal, compliance, and functional teams across the Hilti Group.

**What You'll Do

**Key Responsibilities

• Provide legal and compliance support across the Region, covering project sales, large contracts, and transactional matters.

• Review, draft, mark-up, and support negotiations of complex commercial and project contracts, particularly within offshore energy projects.

• Advise on deal structures and support pre-contract activities, including NDAs, RFPs/RFQs, and bid processes.

• Support project execution phases, including claims management, contractual correspondence, dispute resolution, and interaction with external counsel where required.

• Support the rollout, localization, and implementation of global contracting concepts and compliance initiatives in line with Hilti Group policies.

• Act as the regional interface to global legal subject matter experts, including IP, trade compliance, risk and insurance, tax, and procurement.

• Contribute to compliance training, monitoring, investigations, and reporting in close cooperation with the Head of Legal & Compliance.

• Be an integral part of the Regional Legal & Compliance team and collaborate closely across regions and functions.

**What You’ll Bring

****Qualifications & Experience

**

• Qualified lawyer or legal counsel with approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience from a law firm and/or an international business environment.

• Strong experience in commercial contracting, project negotiations, and business partnering is essential. Admission to practice law is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

• Strong experience in project contracting, including direct customer-facing negotiations within offshore energy (oil & gas or offshore wind).

• Experience with EPCs or large-scale project environments is highly advantageous.

• Broad legal skill set covering commercial contracts, compliance, product liability, corporate matters, and related transactional topics.

• Bachelor’s degree in law from a reputable university; Master’s degree in Law is an advantage.

Personal Attributes

• Commercially minded with strong business acumen and sound judgment.

• Comfortable working independently while thriving in a matrix and international environment.

• Proactive, structured, and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex legal issues into practical business advice.

• Collaborative, inclusive, and confident—with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

• Willingness to travel occasionally, sometimes on short notice.

Languages & IT Skills

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is an advantage.

• Strong IT literacy (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

**What’s In It for You

**Why Join Øglænd / Hilti

• Join a globally recognized company with strong values and a people-focused culture.

• Take on a meaningful and high-impact role from day one.

• Work on complex offshore energy projects with international stakeholders.

• Gain valuable exposure to a global legal and compliance network.

• Be part of a collaborative, high-performing regional and global legal team.

**Why Hilti

**Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion

**At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform.

What You Will Do

• Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs.

• Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base.

• Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product.

• Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns.

• Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product.

• Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product.

What You Could Bring

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side.

• Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems.

• A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users.

• Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs.

• Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features.

• A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

• Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**About The Job

**We're looking for an analytical Platform Integration Specialist to join our Global Platform Configuration team at Saxo. The team is based in Copenhagen & Singapore and this role is based in our headquarters in Copenhagen.

As a Platform Integration Specialist, you will support the technical integration aspects of the onboarding process, working closely with the partner to build API connections. In this role, you will engage in the migration of our partners from SOAP to REST based APIs and from SAML to OIDC authentication protocol. You will participate in review, test, and deployment of new services, and manage ongoing maintenance. In this role, you will become the conduit between technical teams at the partner and Saxo, helping to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Our main objective is to lead the Platform Configuration and IT Integration aspects of the onboarding of new Institutional clients, and support and maintain these elements with existing institutional clients. We manage the entire process as well as configure the trading platform, including feature deployment & branding elements. We lead and configure technical integration efforts (APIs & FTP connections) and project manage all other operations areas to deliver a holistic onboarding experience to the partner.

To succeed in this role, you will need to be resourceful, adaptable, analytical, and well organized. As well as someone who thrives in building rapport with internal and external stakeholders. We have a dynamic, very ambitious and, at the same time, informal and pleasant working environment.

**Responsibilities

**As a Platform Integration Specialist you will be responsible for:

• Facilitating the transition of the client from pre-sales to onboarding, working with pre-sales team to confirm the boundaries of the engagement

• Project management of the technical onboarding, representing not only our own platform branding elements but representing Operations Business Unit

• Managing new client technical IT integrations, this could be via API connections (REST and SOAP) or FTP protocols

• Transition from onboarding to hyper care, managing the handover process to other operations teams who will future service the client

• Additional tasks including document writing, development workshops/coordination, client visits, seminars, or training

**Your profile

**You're Looking For a Client Facing Position And Have a Service-based Mindset. You Are Able To Anticipate Our Partners' Needs And Suggest The Most Appropriate Solutions From Our Technology Stack. Furthermore You Have Several Of The Following

• A BSc within Computer Science and Economics, BSc in Computer Engineering or similar is a must

• 2+ years of experience working with API (SOAP, REST) technologies including analysing and understanding server logs

• Experience working with C#, PHP and Java will be an advantage

• Knowledge or strong interest in investment banking especially in relation to capital markets and financial products (FX, CFDs, equities etc)

• Knowledge and experience in the FinTech is an advantage

• Knowledge of SAML message exchange and or OIDC authentication (certificate based) is considered advantageous but not essential

• Enthusiastic and driven individual who can demonstrate ownership and understand service culture for both internal and external clients

• A self-starter with the drive to form creative solutions and in equal measure be able perform in depth trouble shooting

• Analytical and strong problem solving skills

• Proven communication skills in English both written and spoken

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

**Senior Manager Of Customer Experience & Product At AtNorth

**Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

**Your profile:

**We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

**About The AtNorth Culture

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

**About The Role

**Secomea builds secure remote access for industrial machines. Machine builders and manufacturers use our products to reach and service their equipment in the field without opening up the plant network. The portfolio runs from edge hardware (SiteManager) to our cloud platform, Secomea Prime.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who has built identity and access capabilities in B2B SaaS. You will own identity and access across our portfolio: who can reach which machine, when, with whose approval, and how every session is recorded. You take it from the customer problem to adoption. You report to the Director of Product Management and work in a small team of product managers and UX designers & researchers.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own discovery for your area. Talk to the people who buy and use our products: decision-makers at machine builders, distributors, IT and security leaders at end customers, service technicians, OT engineers and IT administrators. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements and outcomes.

• Decide on commercial grounds. Build the business case for your area (market potential, revenue impact, cost to build, margin) and back your priorities with usage data, win/loss insight and market analysis.

• Know the market. Track competitors, buying behaviour and technology shifts, and spot where Secomea can win.

• Run the roadmap. Plan your area 18 to 36 months ahead, with every theme tied to a customer outcome or a business metric.

• Work closely with engineering. Agree on scope and success criteria together. You own the what and the why; engineering owns the how and estimates the effort.

• Manage the full lifecycle. Weigh new capabilities against the health of live, mission-critical deployments. Set release support windows, end-of-life plans and migration paths for legacy products.

• Keep security and regulation in the plan. IEC 62443 (especially identification, authentication and use control), the EU Cyber Resilience Act and NIS2 shape requirements and release gates for our customers and for us.

• Measure the outcome. Define and track KPIs such as adoption, retention and time-to-value, and use them with customer feedback to decide what comes next.

• Get releases product-ready for go-to-market. Product Marketing owns pricing, packaging, enablement and launch communication. You give them the product input they need: what changes, for whom, why it matters, and the data behind it.

**What You Bring

**

• 6+ years in product management, with a substantial part on a B2B SaaS product.

• Product experience with identity and access management, for example single sign-on, user provisioning, role-based permissions, approval workflows or privileged access.

• Products you took from discovery to launch and kept improving.

• Ownership of a business case or revenue target, and an example of a decision that moved a commercial number.

• Comfort with data: you run your own analyses rather than wait for a report.

• Clear writing, and experience making a case with evidence to engineering, sales and leadership.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience with OT, industrial automation, Industrial IoT or remote access.

• Experience with products that combine cloud, software and hardware.

• Working knowledge of identity standards such as SAML, OIDC and SCIM.

• Working knowledge of IEC 62443, CRA or NIS2.

**This role is not for you if…

**

• You have never managed a B2B SaaS product. OT, hardware or security expertise alone is not enough for this role.

• You see product management as coordination, backlog administration or writing detailed user stories. Our PMs start at the customer problem, set the outcome, and work out the details with the team.

**Why join Secomea?

**At Secomea we rely on initiative and an open mindset, where your creativity and dedication come to use in an open and positive work atmosphere. As we are fast-growing and constantly expanding our business, you will have plenty of chances to grow your responsibilities and competencies while working at the heart of contemporary industrial tech.

We are a truly diverse company with offices placed across the globe, 30+ different nationalities, embracing all genders.

• Your own area. The product team is small, so you own your area end to end and your decisions show up in the product.

• Good timing. CRA and NIS2 raise the bar for remote access in industry, and AI is changing how access is audited and threats are detected. You will help decide how Secomea responds.

• An international team. More than 30 nationalities, with offices in Denmark, China, Japan and North America.

**How to apply

**In your application, describe one product decision you based on data and what it did to revenue, retention or cost.

Some customer needs go beyond the standard setup: a new market to cover, tricky matching, data that's hard to get, or a customer-specific setup for a large enterprise deal. That's where you come in.

As Data Coordinator, you'll combine hands-on data engineering with ownership of complex data tasks and larger customer data projects, for both existing and prospective customers. And you'll help turn one-off solutions into processes and tools we can reuse across customers.

**About The Role

**You'll be part of our Product Success team and work closely with our Product Success Managers, GTM, our Solution Architect and colleagues across Product and Engineering.

You'll work on-site from our Aarhus HQ. English is our working language, and the team is international.

**Delivering data tasks and customer projects

**

When something needs input from Data, Product or Engineering, you pull in the right person.

**Bring your laboratory expertise to a team supporting life-changing therapies

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, our QC Bioassay team plays an important role in ensuring the quality of biopharmaceutical products developed and manufactured for patients around the world.

As QC Bioassay continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Laboratory Technicians to join our team. You will work with specifically in our dedicated Cell-Based Assay Team, support daily laboratory activities, and contribute to analytical testing throughout different stages of pharmaceutical production.

You will join an international and collaborative environment where skilled colleagues work closely together, share knowledge, and support each other in delivering high-quality results.

**Where your laboratory work makes a difference

**As a Senior Laboratory Technician in QC Bioassay, you will be involved in analytical testing of drug substance, drug product, and in-process samples. Your work will also include stability programs and method validations for both early-stage and commercial products.

You will work with complex bioanalytical methods and contribute to developing, establishing, and improving robust assays. Your experience and technical understanding will be important when troubleshooting methods and supporting their continued improvement.

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing Cell-Based Assays.

• Conducting analytical testing of drug substance, drug product, and in-process samples.

• Reporting results, including data processing and setup in LIMS.

• Participating in method validation studies, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of analytical methods.

• Ensuring timely testing of stop/go samples to support our manufacturing facility.

The role offers the opportunity to work with a variety of cell-based potency methods, contribute to their development and optimization, and support both clinical and commercial manufacturing activities.

**A collaborative team with broad analytical expertise

**QC Bioassay is one of five departments within our QC organization at AGC Biologics in Søborg.

Our department consists of 51 skilled Scientists and Technicians, organized into four groups: Bioassay Technicians, Bioassay Scientists, Bioassay Cell-Based, ELISA & Reference Material, and General Analytics.

In your immediate team, you will work alongside five Technicians and four Scientists, with opportunities for technical sparring, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

Together, we perform a broad range of compendial methods, bioassays, and cell-based assays. Our responsibilities include method validations for early and late-stage products, release testing of clinical and commercial batches (DS and DP), and testing of stability samples.

We also support our 24/7 manufacturing operations through the testing of in-process stop/go samples.

You will become part of an international and diverse team with an informal working environment, where close collaboration, knowledge sharing, and supporting new colleagues are important parts of our daily work.

**Bring Your Technical Skills And Structured Approach

**We are looking for a colleague with a degree as a Laboratory Technician (Laborant), ideally combined with at least four years of relevant laboratory experience from an industrial, development, or QC environment.

Experience working in a GMP-regulated laboratory is particularly important, as all our testing is performed according to cGMP.

Hands-on experience with Cell-Based assays is especially valuable for this position. Experience with other bioanalytical methods, including ELISAs, will also be an advantage, although experience with every method is not a requirement to apply.

Our corporate language is English, and you must be fluent in both written and spoken English.

To succeed in the role, you will benefit from a structured approach to your work and the ability to maintain quality when priorities change or deadlines are tight. You enjoy working with complex analytical methods, identifying opportunities for improvement, and collaborating with colleagues to establish reliable and robust solutions.

Good communication skills and a service-minded attitude are also important, as you will collaborate with colleagues across QC and with stakeholders, primarily from Manufacturing.

**Become part of an international QC organization

**We offer a permanent, full-time positions of 37 hours per week at our facility in Søborg.

Together with your colleagues, you will cover the daily laboratory activities, including weekend shifts once or twice a month, depending on the schedule.

You will have the opportunity to gain broad insight into how a QC Bioassay department operates within an international Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), while working alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative environment.

At AGC Biologics, our work is guided by six core values: Knowledge, Trust, Quality, Ingenuity, Accountability, and Teamwork. These values connect our colleagues across three continents and support our shared purpose of bringing hope to life for patients around the globe.

**Join our QC Bioassay team

**Does this sound like your next career opportunity?

We would be pleased to receive your application. Simply apply with your CV through our recruitment system.

This is a highly flexible and varied role where priorities evolve as projects develop. Job Duties & Responsibilities

• Advanced Optical Techniques: Design and apply strategies involving holography, interferometry, computer-generated holograms (CGHs), and compensation strategies.

• Lab & Production Diagnostics: Build and commission optical test systems, analyze measurement data, and conduct hands-on laboratory work to troubleshoot complex optical and manufacturing issues.

• Close collaboration with experienced international teams solving complex technical problems where conventional solutions fall short.

Please describe one technically challenging optical engineering problem that you personally solved. Briefly explain:

• The problem and requirements – What were you trying to achieve, and what made the problem technically challenging?

Please describe how you currently use artificial intelligence (AI) to solve or support development tasks in your present position. Give one or more concrete examples of how you use AI in your engineering work, and briefly explain what value it provides.

We are interested in your actual hands-on use of AI, rather than general views or opinions about the technology.

Senior ERP Systems Consultant – AX 2012 & D365 F&O

Mission

**Do you want to take ownership of two generations of ERP systems at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 and the ambition to play a key role in supporting our current platform while contributing to our transition to D365 F&O? Are you motivated by ensuring system stability and continuous improvement while helping shape the future of our ERP landscape?

If you are a technically strong ERP systems consultant who enjoys solving complex issues, collaborating across IT and the business, and building new capabilities for the future, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkReporting to our Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business consultants, developers, architects, integration specialists and stakeholders across our international organisation.

As a Senior ERP Systems Consultant, your initial focus will be our existing Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 platform, where you will ensure system stability, performance, technical quality and continuous improvement. As we transition from AX 2012 to D365 F&O, your role will evolve alongside our ERP landscape.

Senior ERP Systems Consultant with a focus on AX 2012 and D365 F&OYou will be our senior technical expert on AX 2012, acting as the escalation point for complex issues and safeguarding critical system knowledge. Working closely with developers, architects and business consultants, you will balance technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements while ensuring that solutions meet our development, documentation and architectural standards.

You will also bring critical AX 2012 knowledge into our transition to D365 F&O, building hands-on experience with the new platform and gradually taking on systems responsibility for the new solution. This is not just an AX 2012 role – it is an opportunity to take ownership across two generations of our ERP landscape and become a key part of our future D365 F&O organisation.

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:

• Act as the senior systems and technical expert for our Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 environment, ensuring stability, performance, maintainability and architectural integrity.

• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and act as the escalation point for critical incidents.

• Work hands-on with AX 2012 development, X++, customisations, integrations, SQL Server and performance optimisation.

• Review technical solutions and ensure adherence to development, documentation and architectural standards, balancing technical debt, maintenance and business-requested enhancements.

• Protect and strengthen critical AX 2012 knowledge through documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Identify customisations, integrations, data dependencies and technical risks in the existing solution as input to the transition to D365 F&O.

• Contribute to solution assessment, data migration, testing, validation and cutover preparation in close collaboration with D365 F&O consultants, developers, architects and integration specialists.

• Build hands-on D365 F&O knowledge and progressively take on responsibility for the operation, maintenance, configuration, release readiness and continuous improvement of the new platform.

Profile

Qualifications & requirementsYou bring extensive hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, supported by several years of experience from complex, business-critical ERP environments. You combine strong technical problem-solving skills with a structured approach to quality and documentation, and you are motivated by the opportunity to apply your AX 2012 expertise during the transition while developing your future role within D365 F&O.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, including System administration, development and architecture.

• Solid experience with X++ development and customization.

• Good understanding of SQL Server, databases, integrations and performance optimization.

• Experience from complex and business-critical ERP environments.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.

• The ability to balance operational stability, technical debt, transformation activities and business requirements.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

It is an advantage if you have:

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.

• Experience from an AX 2012 to D365 F&O migration or another ERP transformation programme.

• Experience with Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services, data entities, security, workflows or release management in D365 F&O.

• Knowledge of cloud ERP operations, automated testing or the Microsoft Power Platform.

• A relevant degree or Microsoft Dynamics certification.

Personality mattersYou are curious, analytical and collaborative, with a natural ability to take ownership and build trusted relationships across the business and IT. You enjoy solving complex problems, constructively challenging existing solutions and translating technical insight into sustainable improvements. You communicate clearly and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

**We offer more than just a job

**We wish to be the best at what we do, and everything we do is based on our values of “Winning Attitude, Customer Orientation, and Getting it Done”. We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

**Ready to apply?

**Please send us your application and CV via the “Apply” button. We want to fill the position as soon as possible and will continuously invite candidates for interviews, so do not hesitate to submit your application and CV.

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Thomas Jørsfeldt, at thjo@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2128 4416

**At Wrist, we are committed to cultivating a culture of belonging where every individual feels seen, valued, and respected

**As a global company, we aim to reflect the communities we are part of, believing that our strength comes from diverse perspectives, experiences, and the unique contributions each person offers. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and we are dedicated to maintaining a recruitment process that is inclusive, fair, and respectful. By fostering a supportive workplace culture rooted in belonging, we lay the foundation for meaningful collaboration and shared success.

**About Wrist

**Wrist is the world’s leading ship and offshore supplier of marine provisions and stores with a market share of approximately 12%. We are the only provisions and stores marine supplier with a global network of supply operations. We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. With the launch of the digital marketplace, Source2Sea, Wrist is leading the digital transformation of the marine supply industry. All year round, we offer 24/7 global online sourcing and logistics, providing data transparency, automation, and convenience to our customers. We continuously work on reducing our climate impact while at the same time proactively addressing our customers’ growing demand and need for responsible solutions and services. From more than 30 locations worldwide, in all major shipping locations, 1,800 Wrist employees take pride in making it easy for our customers to order and receive marine supplies and services.

Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation

Help shape how Danske Bank manages risk and compliance through technology that makes a measurable difference. As Head of Risk & Compliance Innovation, you will build and lead a new team, turning complex challenges into practical products, scalable solutions and better ways of working. This is an opportunity to create a new capability and bring innovation into everyday practice across the Risk and Compliance function.

What you will be doing

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of approximately 15 colleagues, combining technology and product specialists with PMO and change-delivery professionals. Reporting to James Mackintosh, Head of Enterprise Risk Management, you will work across Risk and Compliance with senior leaders, subject-matter experts and Technology teams. You will set clear direction while building a culture of trust, collaboration and shared responsibility for results.

More specifically, you will:

• Build and lead the Risk and Compliance Innovation team, creating clarity, collaboration and a strong focus on delivery.

• Shape and deliver a technology and change portfolio aligned to strategic, regulatory and operational priorities.

• Deliver practical, production-ready solutions, including AI use cases such as regulatory traceability and digital-twin approaches.

• Translate complex problems into clear product propositions, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.

• Prioritise the team portfolio and budget, making transparent choices and adapting where the expected value is not being realised.

• Establish proportionate delivery governance that supports transparency, sound controls and timely decisions.

About you

• Significant leadership experience in banking or another highly regulated financial-services environment.

• A strong track record of technology and product delivery, from concept through to production and measurable impact.

• Experience using AI, automation and data to improve control, insight, productivity or decision-making.

• Experience leading major transformation programmes across organisational boundaries.

• The ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects and data specialists, without needing to code directly.

• Strong portfolio and commercial judgement, including prioritisation, budgeting and resource allocation.

You will be a collaborative, down-to-earth leader who provides clear direction, listens to different perspectives and helps colleagues turn ideas into practical results. Experience owning products while commissioning delivery from technology partners, or helping recover challenged programmes, would be valuable. Experience working with agile tribes and squads, aligning priorities with product owners and coordinating delivery across teams, would also be an advantage, as well as a background spanning technical delivery and change management.

What we offer you

You will join a collaborative environment where your work can make a meaningful difference to how a major bank manages risk. We offer a hybrid working model with three to four days per week in the office. You will have access to senior stakeholders, an organisation-wide mandate and the opportunity to build a new capability across Risk and Compliance.

Are you ready for the next step?

If this sounds like the right move for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Contact hiring manager James Mackintosh at jamma@danskebank.dk with any questions, or apply directly through this posting. Please submit your application by 1 December 2026.

We look forward to hearing from you!
